title: Recurrent neural chemical reaction networks trained to switch dynamical behaviours through learned bifurcations
summary: Both natural and synthetic chemical systems not only exhibit a range of non-trivial dynamics, but also transition between qualitatively different dynamical behaviours as environmental parameters change. Such transitions are called bifurcations. Here, we show that recurrent neural chemical reaction networks (RNCRNs), a class of chemical reaction networks based on recurrent artificial neural networks that can be trained to reproduce a given dynamical behaviour, can also be trained to exhibit bifurcations.
